title: Share of the Year Credited on a Discount Restart, by RentGuard Billing Plan
content:
Billing manual, restart proration by billing plan. For a RentGuard Renters Policy owed a credit when its multi-policy discount restarts, the share of the year credited for the restart follows the billing plan of the renters policy.

1. **Monthly EFT plan or monthly card plan.** The share of the year credited for the restart is the number of 30-day periods in the days credited for the restart, a part period counted as a whole one, divided by 12.
2. **Two-pay plan.** The share is the days credited for the restart divided by 360.
3. **Any other plan (the annual plan).** The share is the days credited for the restart divided by the calendar days in the renters term.

### Counting 30-day periods on the monthly plans

| Days credited (hypothetical) | 30-day periods counted | Share of the year |
|---|---|---|
| 60 | 2 | 2 divided by 12 |
| 61 | 3 (the 1 remaining day counts as a whole period) | 3 divided by 12 |
| 90 | 3 | 3 divided by 12 |
| 91 | 4 | 4 divided by 12 |

### Other plans, hypothetical figures

- Two-pay plan with 72 days credited: 72 divided by 360, a share of 0.2.
- Annual plan with 73 days credited in a 365-day renters term: 73 divided by 365, a share of 0.2.
